multi.title: Multiplayer
multi.intro_desc: One challenge a day, the same for your whole group, on a server one of you hosts.
multi.intro_step_server: A friend creates a server (Docker) and invites you with a link or a QR code.
multi.intro_step_daily: Every day, a new multiplayer challenge: one try, the clock runs as soon as you start.
multi.intro_step_rank: Rankings of the day (moves, then time), of the week and of the month.
multi.intro_optional: Completely optional: it never touches your progress or your streak.
multi.pending: Your game from yesterday can still be finished: {{time}}
multi.my_abandoned: Given up. The optimum was {{min}} moves.
multi.my_unfinished: Unfinished game. The optimum was {{min}} moves.
multi.invite_desc: Your friend scans this QR code with their phone camera, or opens the link, to join {{server}}.
multi.invite_message: Join me on Rush Hours for the "{{server}}" multiplayer challenge: {{link}}
multi.account_gone_body: This server no longer knows you (account deleted or moved to another phone). Remove it from the list?
multi.join_desc: The address and the invite code are in the link your friend sent you.
multi.recover_desc: Your recovery code is in "My account" on your old phone. The old phone will be signed out.
multi.have_account: I already have an account on this server
multi.join_tip: Tip: paste the invitation link here, everything fills in by itself.
multi.already_joined_body: You already have an account on this server. Creating a new one will lose access to the old one on this phone (keep your recovery code).
multi.create_desc: The server is a small program run with Docker. You choose when the challenge comes out, its difficulty, and who you invite.
multi.create_need_machine: a machine that is always on, with Docker (server, NAS, Raspberry Pi…)
multi.create_need_domain: a domain name (free with duckdns, for example)
multi.create_then_join: My server is ready: join it
multi.recovery_desc: Keep it safe: it gets your account back on another phone. Don't share it.
multi.renew_code_body: The old code will stop working. Continue?
multi.leave_body: Your account stays on the server: you can come back with your recovery code. Write it down before leaving.
multi.delete_body: Your account and all your games will be erased from {{server}}. This cannot be undone.
multi.clock_runs: The clock keeps running even if you leave the screen.
multi.abandon_body: The game ends and cannot be resumed. You will see the optimum.
multi.admin_claim_help: If you created this server, enter its ADMIN_TOKEN (in your docker-compose.yml).
multi.admin_confirm_cheater_body: {{pseudo}} will show as a cheater for this challenge, at their rank but with 0 points. You can undo it.
multi.admin_ban_body: {{pseudo}} will no longer be able to play and will leave the rankings. Change the invite code if they must not come back.
multi.admin_transfer_body: For {{pseudo}}, who lost their code: the old one will stop working.
multi.admin_delete_player_body: The account of {{pseudo}}, their games, duels and reports will be erased from this server. This cannot be undone. Change the invite code if they must not come back.
multi.admin_puzzles_help: The duel puzzles prepared ahead on the server: a duel takes the next one of its difficulty and starts at once.
multi.admin_puzzles_working_scratch: In progress: a {{difficulty}} puzzle, for {{minutes}} min
multi.admin_puzzles_working_catalog: In progress: the {{difficulty}} catalog of variants, for {{minutes}} min
multi.admin_puzzles_spoiler: These are the puzzles of your next duels: if you play, you'll see them ahead.
multi.admin_puzzles_aside: Too long to generate: left aside until {{time}}
multi.admin_puzzles_old_server: Your server is too old to show its puzzles: update it.
multi.admin_new_invite_body: Old invitation links will stop working. Players who already joined are not affected.
multi.admin_release_help: In the server's time ({{zone}}). A change applies from the next challenge on: the current one is not taken away, it just lasts longer or shorter.
multi.admin_release_confirm_body: From the next challenge on. The current challenge stays playable until that new release.
multi.admin_schedule_help: Grace period: the time left to finish a game started before the next challenge came out. Pregeneration: how long before its release a puzzle is prepared.
multi.admin_difficulty_help: Tap a day to choose its difficulty. Only the challenges not out yet change.
multi.admin_thresholds_help: A game beyond a threshold is marked suspect, with the reason, for everyone to see. Nothing is punished without your decision.
multi.admin_reset_help: Reset the challenges and/or the duels, for a period and chosen players: handy to start a new season. It cannot be undone.
multi.admin_reset_body: Every setting goes back to the docker-compose.yml. The release time changes from the next challenge on.
multi.cheater_note: Cheating confirmed by the admin: 0 points

flag.copied: solved without a hesitation after a {{pause}} pause ({{percent}}% of the game)

multi.report_help: The report goes to the admin of the server, not to the player.
multi.report_sent_body: The admin of the server will take care of it.
multi.block_help: Blocking hides this player from the rankings on your phone only.
multi.win_suspect: Game marked suspect: the admin can review it.
multi.setup_needs_help: About half an hour if Docker and nginx are already installed. The server is light: a Raspberry Pi is enough.
multi.setup_bad_time: A time as HH:MM, for example 12:00.
multi.setup_time_zone: Time zone: {{zone}} (the one of your phone).
multi.setup_choices_help: Everything can be changed later from the admin panel of the app, without a restart.
multi.setup_secrets_help: On your machine, run this command twice. Paste the first result instead of {{placeholder}} for SERVER_SECRET, the second for ADMIN_TOKEN. Never share SERVER_SECRET: it lets anyone compute the puzzles in advance.
multi.setup_compose_help: Create a folder (for example rush-hours), put this file in it, then replace the two secrets.
multi.setup_nginx_help: Add this site to nginx (for example /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/rush-hours) and reload nginx. The server only listens on the machine: nginx handles the Internet and HTTPS.
multi.setup_certificate_help: The HTTPS certificate comes from Let's Encrypt, for example: sudo certbot certonly --nginx -d {{domain}}
multi.setup_start_help: In the folder of the file:
multi.setup_invite_help: The invite code is generated at the first start, it is in the logs:
multi.setup_test_help: From this phone, check that the server answers over HTTPS and works with the app.
multi.setup_test_ok: The server "{{name}}" answers and works with the app!

setup_test_fail.reach: No answer: check the domain (DNS), port 443 of your router, the certificate and that nginx runs.
setup_test_fail.server: Something answers, but not the Rush Hours server: check the proxy_pass of nginx and that the container runs (docker compose ps).
setup_test_fail.version: The server answers, but the versions do not match.

multi.setup_join_help: Join your server with the invite code, then in My account → Become admin, enter your ADMIN_TOKEN. You can then invite your friends.
multi.start_hint: One try: the clock runs as soon as you start.
multi.admin_reset_challenges_help: The games, so the rankings of the day, the week and the month.
multi.admin_reset_duels_help: The history, the scores between players and the duel ranking.
multi.admin_reset_nothing: Choose what to delete and for whom.
multi.admin_reset_none: Nothing to delete for this choice.
multi.admin_reset_replay_note: A player whose game of the current challenge is deleted can play it again.
multi.admin_reset_duel_note: A deleted duel is deleted for its opponent too.
multi.admin_reset_confirm_body: {{who}}, {{when}}: {{challenges}} and {{duels}} will be deleted. It cannot be undone.

duel.button_hint: Play a member of the server live on the same puzzle
duel.title: 1v1 duel
duel.give_code: Private duel: give this code to your opponent.
duel.share_message: Come and duel me on Rush Hours ({{server}})! Multiplayer → 1v1 duel → code: {{code}}
duel.leave_body: Leaving now means losing the duel.
duel.spectator_rematch: If they play a rematch, you'll watch it too.
duel.card_desc: Play a member of the server live, on the same puzzle: the fastest or the fewest moves wins, you choose.
duel.none_open: No open duel for now. Start the first one!
duel.have_code: I have a private duel code
duel.public_help: Visible to every player of the server: the first one to join it plays you.
duel.private_help: Hidden from the list: only who has the code can join it.
duel.code_help: Type the code your opponent gave you.
duel.listed: Visible to every player of {{server}}. To invite someone directly, share this code.
duel.ranking_empty: No duel played in this period.
duel.history_empty: Your finished duels will show here.
duel.metric_time_help: The first to get the red car out wins.
duel.metric_moves_help: The fewest moves to get the red car out wins; on a tie, the fastest. Who finishes first waits for the other.
duel.won_on_moves: Fewest moves wins, the fastest on a tie.

errors.network: The server does not answer. Check your connection and the server address.
errors.timeout: The server takes too long to answer. Try again.
errors.bad_response: This is not a Rush Hours server (check the address).
errors.internal: The server ran into a problem. Try again later.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a little before trying again.
errors.unauthorized: This server no longer knows you: account deleted or moved to another phone.
errors.invalid_pseudo: Invalid nickname: 2 to 20 characters, letters, digits, spaces, . _ -
errors.pseudo_taken: This nickname is already taken on this server.
errors.preparing: The challenge is being prepared. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.too_late: Time is up: the game no longer counts.
errors.no_game: No game in progress for this challenge.
errors.invalid_moves: The server could not check your game.
errors.not_won: The server did not see a win in your game.
errors.not_https: The server must use https:// (phones block http://).
errors.update_app: This server needs a newer version of the app: update it.
errors.update_server: This server is too old for this version of the app: ask its admin to update it.
errors.banned: The admin of this server excluded you.
errors.forbidden: For the admin of the server only.
errors.join_closed: Joining is closed on this server.
errors.invites_admin_only: Only the admin of this server can invite.
errors.cannot_delete_admin: An admin cannot be deleted here: they delete their account from My account.
errors.release_too_soon: The next challenge would come out in less than an hour: choose a later time.
errors.replay_locked: Finish your own game of the day first to watch the others'.
errors.replay_expired: The replay of this game is no longer kept.
errors.duel_not_found: No duel with this code (check it, or it was cancelled).
errors.duel_full: This duel already has its two players.
errors.already_in_duel: You are already in a duel.
errors.not_started: The duel has not started yet.
errors.duel_unreachable: Cannot open the duel: the reverse proxy of the server must let WebSockets through (see the server guide).
errors.duel_replaced: Your account now plays on another phone: the duel goes on there.
errors.puzzle_unavailable: The server could not prepare a puzzle for this duel. Try again, or pick another level.
errors.too_many_spectators: Too many people are already watching this duel. Try again later.
